title: Cohort Retention Matrix
description:
In product analytics, cohort retention analyzes how user engagement evolves over successive time intervals relative to their sign-up date.

Given a transaction or activity dataset with columns `[user_id, event_date]`, construct a **Cohort Retention Matrix**:
1. Determine each user's acquisition cohort (month/week of their first activity).
2. Calculate the retention period offset for subsequent activity events.
3. Compute the percentage of cohort members active in each subsequent period relative to period 0.
